description: All-GPT codex line — flash uses gpt-5.1-codex-mini to keep entry costs low while still supporting attachments, standard runs vanilla gpt-5.1 for general orchestrations, pro steps up to gpt-5.3-codex for the coding-heavy work, and max stays review-capable with gpt-5.6-terra inside the $3/$15 red line; vision reuses gpt-5.1-codex-mini for multimodal tasks. Requires OPENCODE_API_KEY environment variable (OpenCode Zen).
